labels.good_intern: Candidate meets the reviewer's objective job-relevant suitability criteria for the relevant internship/domain. Exhibits required technical skills, relevant projects, experience, or academic alignment.
labels.bad_intern: Candidate does not meet the reviewer's objective minimum job-relevant criteria for the relevant internship/domain. Lacks required technical foundation, relevant background, or sufficient evidence of capability.
labels.exclude: Record should not be used for training, for example corrupted, duplicate, unusable, image-only, or fundamentally out-of-scope resume.
labels.unreviewed: Manual review not completed. Record will not be included in ML training sets.

forbidden_criteria: college prestige as an automatic proxy for competence
